content_units: Weekly Sales Snapshot
-   4 weeks  ,   3 regions  ,   12 records   total.
- Total sales:   $151,290
- Total returns:   6,060
- Overall return rate:   4.0%
- Highest sales region overall:   West   with   $58,570
- Highest returns region overall:   South   with   2,820   and the weakest return rate
Regional Trend and Outlier Highlights
Region   Total Sales   Avg Weekly Sales   Total Returns   Return Rate   Trend/Outlier Signal
North   52,070   13,017.5   1,655   3.2%   Steady upward trend; best return control
South   40,650   10,162.5   2,820   6.9%   Most volatile; returns spike on 2026-01-19
West   58,570   14,642.5   1,585   2.7%   Strongest sales; consistently low returns
Key takeaways
-   West   led every week in sales, rising from   14,300   to   15,220   with only minor return variation.
-   North   showed a healthy upward trend overall, finishing strong at   13,820   while keeping returns low and stable.
-   South   underperformed on both consistency and quality: sales dipped to   9,600   on   2026-01-19   while returns jumped to   850  , the clearest outlier in the dataset.
- Best single sales week:   West on 2026-01-26   with   15,220
- Worst return event:   South on 2026-01-19   with   850   returns

Best Charts for Trends and Outliers
1) Multi-series line chart for weekly sales and returns
Why it works:
- Best for showing   week-over-week trend direction
- Makes the   West growth pattern   and   North improvement   easy to see
- Clearly exposes the   South returns spike   on   2026-01-19
Recommended setup:
- X-axis:   Week
- Y-axis:   Value
- Series:   Sales by region
- Optional second version:   Returns by region
- Use separate panels or dual small multiples rather than forcing sales and returns onto one crowded axis
2) Scatter plot of sales vs returns by region-week
Why it works:
- Best for spotting   outliers and performance imbalance
- Shows whether higher sales are associated with unusually high returns
- The   South 2026-01-19   point will stand out immediately as   low sales + high returns
Recommended setup:
- X-axis:   Sales
- Y-axis:   Returns
- Color:   Region
- Label or tooltip:   Week
- Add a reference line for average return rate if possible
Quick Actions
- Chart title:   Weekly Sales Trend by Region
- Chart title:   Sales vs Returns Outlier Map
